Hub file `multi_tower_N4096_fp16fc.tflite` 660,721,136 B at Hub commit(s) be1043e2, 4105cd32, 672db2e3, 7f589bb7; artifact_sha256 = its LFS oid = the phone's read-back in each run's hold. One file with 6 signatures (tower_N1024, tower_N1600, tower_N2304, tower_N400, tower_N4096_qb1024, tower_N576: the subgraph names of the delegate lines); each result names the signature it ran. tower_N1024: inputs patches float32 [1,1024,1536], valid float32 [1,1024], pos float32 [1,1024,1024], cos float32 [1,1024,64], sin float32 [1,1024,64] -> outputs rows float32 [1,256,2048]. tower_N1600: inputs patches float32 [1,1600,1536], valid float32 [1,1600], pos float32 [1,1600,1024], cos float32 [1,1600,64], sin float32 [1,1600,64] -> outputs rows float32 [1,400,2048]. tower_N2304: inputs patches float32 [1,2304,1536], valid float32 [1,2304], pos float32 [1,2304,1024], cos float32 [1,2304,64], sin float32 [1,2304,64] -> outputs rows float32 [1,576,2048]. tower_N400: inputs patches float32 [1,400,1536], valid float32 [1,400], pos float32 [1,400,1024], cos float32 [1,400,64], sin float32 [1,400,64] -> outputs rows float32 [1,100,2048]. tower_N4096_qb1024: inputs patches float32 [1,4096,1536], valid float32 [1,4096], pos float32 [1,4096,1024], cos float32 [1,4096,64], sin float32 [1,4096,64] -> outputs rows float32 [1,1024,2048]. tower_N576: inputs patches float32 [1,576,1536], valid float32 [1,576], pos float32 [1,576,1024], cos float32 [1,576,64], sin float32 [1,576,64] -> outputs rows float32 [1,144,2048]. Measured on the Pixel 11 Pro (device holds of runs r3): one result per run, and per timing set in a timing run. output_match is null on every result: the work compares each row with its own Mac Metal fp32 run of the same rows (metrics.vs_mac_metal_fp32_*: max |d| and the smallest cosine over the rows with the same input bytes), not with a CPU reference of the same bytes under the element rule.
